purpose: Selected scientific parameters and input identities from original freezes; reference only, not a replacement freeze, runtime gate or checkpoint.

protocol.constraints: E=max absolute error, R=original/reconstructed window Pearson, A=max slice-Pearson ACF gap at lags 1..16; report strict and 64*float64-eps audits.
protocol.consumers: Frozen Raw-trained Ridge,DLinear,PatchTST3seeds,Chronos2,ChronosBoltSmall,TimesFM3; UCR1NN,Logistic,ResNetv1/v2,shape/deep retrieval; NASA Ridge/KNN/LSTM3seeds.
protocol.container: Identical JZF1 complete wrapper for both policies: channel, normalizer, shape, true flattened count, JZP1 independently decoded records; all bytes billed. NASA padded suffix excluded from raw numerator.
protocol.correction: Original posthoc greedy, legacy optimizer, original values plus 7/15/31/63/127 targets; formats0-6; no later complex coding.
protocol.density: First series from each of ETTm1,ETTm2,ElecDem,Weather,Wind,Solar; first four VAL windows, strict/loose, SZ3/ZFP; formula/noformula22/44/88 preserving default initial12 and prefix.
protocol.development_status: Exploratory extension on previously inspected datasets, not a wholly unseen confirmatory benchmark.
protocol.formula_role: Source-dependent proposal anchors; permitted relaxation to epsilon; final decode/simple repair/validation provides the contract. No deterministic nonlinear ACF guarantee from proposals.
protocol.native: Same official backend/mode/precision and epsilon, one native encode per window, no statistical repair. SPERR is official SPECK1D_FLT as in historical standalone baseline, not portfolio2D.
protocol.policy: Frozen Oct13/14 formula scalar proposals; SZ3/ZFP/SPERR 22 attempts with 12 initial, Serf 8 with 5 initial; byte-guided refinement; no old grid fallback.
protocol.reuse: Historical four native payloads and matching complete pilot searches reused; independently decode reframed bytes. Exact-input/runtime checked downstream reuse. Never transplant old CR or encoding speed.
protocol.scope: All original 172 inputs; five fixed backends, native versus JointZip; 930 conditions per method, 9300 total.
protocol.selection: Fixed original thresholds; all forecast VAL before TEST. No policy or sample selection from new TEST. Density ablation uses VAL only and does not change main policy.
protocol.timing: Concurrent compression and reused rows are not fresh codec speed. Separate fixed panel standalone native/framework paired timings only.

protocol.constraints: E=max absolute error, R=original/reconstructed window Pearson, A=max slice-Pearson ACF gap at lags 1..16; report strict and 64*float64-eps audits.
protocol.consumers: Frozen Raw-trained Ridge,DLinear,PatchTST3seeds,Chronos2,ChronosBoltSmall,TimesFM3; UCR1NN,Logistic,ResNetv1/v2,shape/deep retrieval; NASA Ridge/KNN/LSTM3seeds.
protocol.container: Identical JZF1 complete wrapper for both policies: channel, normalizer, shape, true flattened count, JZP1 independently decoded records; all bytes billed. NASA padded suffix excluded from raw numerator.
protocol.correction: Original posthoc greedy, legacy optimizer, original values plus 7/15/31/63/127 targets; formats0-6; no later complex coding.
protocol.density: No new density sweep. The completed five-backend parent has a separate SZ3/ZFP VAL-only formula/noformula22/44/88 diagnostic; it is not evidence specific to SZ2016.
protocol.dependency: Start only after vldb_framework_full_20261015_v1 scientific, density, timing, closeout and Windows export gates all pass.
protocol.development_status: Exploratory extension with a backend chosen after inspecting earlier experiments, not a wholly unseen confirmatory benchmark. All outcomes retained.
protocol.formula_role: Source-dependent proposal anchors; permitted relaxation to epsilon; final decode/simple repair/validation provides the contract. No deterministic nonlinear ACF guarantee from proposals.
protocol.native: Same official SZ2016 backend/mode/precision and epsilon as the historical standalone baseline, one native encode per window, no statistical repair.
protocol.policy: Frozen Oct13/14 formula scalar proposals; SZ2016 22 attempts with 12 initial; byte-guided refinement; no old grid fallback.
protocol.reuse: Historical SZ2016 native payloads reused and independently decoded after reframing. Exact-input/runtime checked downstream reuse. Never transplant old CR or encoding speed.
protocol.scope: All original 172 inputs; SZ2016 native versus JointZip; 930 conditions per method, 1860 total.
protocol.selection: Fixed original thresholds; all forecast VAL before TEST. No policy or sample selection from new TEST. Report all planned inputs, thresholds and consumers, including declines.
protocol.timing: Six forecast sources, first four VAL windows, strict/loose; 12 native/framework pairs, one warmup plus three measured calls per cell, 96 calls. Concurrent compression and reused rows are not fresh codec speed.

protocol.constraints: E=max absolute error, R=source/reconstructed Pearson, A=max slice-Pearson ACF gap lags1..16. Disabled R/A is -1 for anchor, repair, final enabled audit; all ERA metrics still recorded.
protocol.consumers: Same frozen Raw-trained models, preprocessing, batches, seeds and runtime; no training; all forecast VAL before TEST. Exact-input historical and current-panel reuse.
protocol.container: Unchanged JZF1/JZP1, complete bytes including normalizer/channel/shape/true count and repairs. Unpadded Float32 numerator.
protocol.correction: Original posthoc greedy, legacy optimizer, original plus 7/15/31/63/127 targets, formats0-6.
protocol.correction_ablation: Freeze existing ERA per-window ordered logical cap trace, including duplicate effective ZFP caps. Disable correction only, audit base E/R/A plus original cap eligibility, retain same exact fallback and byte/cap tie rule. Conditional on the full framework candidate pool, not an independently adapted no-repair search.
protocol.policy: Default formula scalar proposals 22/12/divisor512 for SZ3,ZFP,SPERR1D,SZ2016; 8/5/64 for Serf. No grid, density changes, TEST selection or complex coding.
protocol.reuse: Existing ERA full streams/reconstructions/metadata and matching downstream arrays reused. Native winner base payloads and matching candidate bases reused; unselected unstored bases computed once. Cross-arm native cache excludes repair thresholds, includes exact source/backend/effective native parameter.
protocol.scope: Same 172 inputs, six fixed backends, five arms; 27900 compression rows including 5580 reused ERA rows.
protocol.selection: All original thresholds, datasets, seeds and tasks retained; report improvements, ties, declines, lossless fallback and repaired bytes. Current data were seen during method development.
protocol.timing: No new end-to-end speed ranking from parallel or cached work. Correction-specific fixed-pool replay costs are diagnostics only, not autonomous algorithm encoding throughput.

ford_acf.input: Official existing per-record z-scored sequences cast to float32, no additional fitted normalization or padding; one record=one 500-point window.
ford_acf.scope: All official TEST records: FordA1320/FordB810, no case filtering or retuning. TRAIN only fits consumers and selects lag coverage.

consumers.primary: catch22 all22 sorted by name + TRAIN median imputation + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1,class_weight=balanced,solver=lbfgs,max_iter=5000,random_state=20261028)
consumers.complementary: 32 equal-width frequency bands of relative one-sided boxcar periodogram energy excluding DC; same raw-TRAIN fitted pipeline
consumers.mechanism_only: CO_FirstMin_ac alone with same pipeline; traditional global-mean ACF definition differs from JointZip slice-Pearson contract

ford_acf.codec: Unchanged framework_ablation_20261017 codec; original formula22/12/512; original simple legacy greedy correction formats0-6. Disable A with tau=-1 for ER.
ford_acf.archive: One complete JZF1 file per dataset/backend/arm, formed losslessly from completed batch records; full metadata billed. Batch files are checkpoints, not reported denominator.
ford_acf.cache: Exact native unrepaired candidate cache shared across arms; no encoding speed claims.
ford_acf.test_feedback: No TEST performance is used to select datasets, parameters, lag, consumer, or cases.

common_accounting.scope: All 172 original TEST inputs; all 3024 ERA JointZip TEST conditions; Zstd lossless reference.
common_accounting.encoding: No encoding. Copy complete saved JointZip JZP1 and lossless NCS collections byte-for-byte.
common_accounting.common_format: JCF1: 4-byte magic + uint32 JSON length + identical per-input JZF1 JSON + self-identifying codec payload.
common_accounting.jointzip_payload: Unchanged JZP1, including its 4-byte dispatch magic, all records, bases, corrections and whole-stream compression.
common_accounting.lossless_payload: 4-byte ZLC1 dispatch magic + unchanged complete NCS1/NCS2 collection, including closure mode and lengths, ZSL1 shape and window boundaries.
common_accounting.lossless_codec: Saved windowed Zstd level19 with batch closure selected among raw/levels3,9,15,19. Not the internal Zstd3 fallback.
common_accounting.provenance: External manifest for both methods, excluded from both stored files. All required decoding metadata counted.
common_accounting.channel_policy: Use current input schema channel from JZF1 on both sides. Record historical channel names externally.
common_accounting.aggregation: First geometric mean within each source, then equal sources. Forecast and NASA settings equally represented; UCR stress only.
common_accounting.verification: All lossless files independently decoded bit-exact. All JointZip inner payloads and full original-file reconstruction hashes verified unchanged, with existing independent-decode evidence reused.
